title: Lesson 8 - Data Ethics and Consent: Trusted AI Principles, Consent Management, and Data Subject Rights
description: Describe the principles of data ethics and governance, covering ethical practice (Trusted AI principles, consent management and enforcement at activation, and data subject rights).

questions.question: A marketer activates a segment that must exclude customers who opted out of marketing. How does Data 360 enforce this?
options: Consent is enforced only in the destination channel
Consent-aware activation evaluates flags such as Do Not Sell or Email Opt-Out and excludes non-consented records before sharing
Consent cannot be enforced at activation
Consent is enforced by deleting the segment
questions.explanation: At activation, Data 360 evaluates consent flags and automatically excludes records that violate them, so enforcement happens before sharing. The strongest distractor places enforcement only in the channel and misses platform-level enforcement.

questions.question: A customer exercises a GDPR right to erasure. What is the recommended way to submit the request in Data 360?
options: Exclude the customer from all segments
Delete the record manually in CRM only
Submit the data subject rights request through the Salesforce Consent API
Set the record's consent flag to opt-out
questions.explanation: Data subject rights requests, including the right to be forgotten, are submitted through the Salesforce Consent API and cover Data 360 as well as CRM. Manual CRM deletion misses the Data 360 data.

questions.question: Which list best reflects Salesforce's Trusted AI principles?
options: Zero Copy, Data Cloud One, Data Spaces, Credits
questions.explanation: Salesforce's Trusted AI principles are Accuracy, Safety, Transparency, Empowerment, and Sustainability. The product-feature option confuses Data 360 capabilities with ethics principles.
